description:
*“Was this kind of machine really that good?”* 

So-Eun swallowed hard and stepped back as soon as she saw her husband holding her dildo. She could feel his chest heaving through his tight shirt. His cold eyes told her that he was very angry.

 *“You’ve been going to adult stores often. Are you trying to embarrass me? Don’t forget your duty. You’re the vice president’s wife.”*

So-Eun, who was shocked by the cold tone she had never heard before, lowered her eyes and a large hand grabbed her chin. He had never treated her this harshly, so she trembled in fear. So-Eun’s body trembled and her teeth chattered. She could sense the contempt directed at her in his refined voice. On the contrary, she felt that she would also get goosebumps if she thought of her husband having such a masturbation device. So-Eun, who felt that she had to apologize, opened her mouth with tears in her eyes.

 *“I’m sorry… I just… I was curious…”*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Bimil Danpyeonseon (비밀 단편선) Collection.*
